---
listing:
  - id: talks
    contents: "**/*/index.qmd"
    type: grid
    fields: [image, date, title, subtitle]
    sort: "date desc"
title-block-banner: false
comments: false
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---

<style>
  .blog-hero {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #64a19d, #7464a1);
    color: white;
    padding: 4rem 0;
    text-align: center;
  }
  
  .blog-content {
    padding: 4rem 0;
  }
  
  .post-card {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 15px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid #e9ecef;
    height: 100%;
  }
  
  .post-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  }
  
  .post-image {
    height: 200px;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    position: relative;
  }
  
  .post-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(100, 161, 157, 0.8);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .post-card:hover .post-overlay {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  
  .post-content {
    padding: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: calc(100% - 200px);
  }
  
  .post-date {
    color: #64a19d;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  
  .post-title {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    color: #333;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  
  .post-subtitle {
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    flex-grow: 1;
  }
  
  .post-categories {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  
  .category-tag {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    color: #64a19d;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    border: 1px solid #e9ecef;
  }
  
  .read-more {
    color: #64a19d;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .read-more:hover {
    color: #50817e;
  }
  
  .read-more i {
    margin-left: 0.5rem;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  .read-more:hover i {
    transform: translateX(3px);
  }
  
  .no-posts {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 4rem 0;
    color: #666;
  }
  
  .no-posts i {
    font-size: 4rem;
    color: #64a19d;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
</style>

```{=html}
<div class="blog-hero">
    <div class="container">
        <h1 class="display-4 fw-bold mb-3">Data Science Blog</h1>
        <p class="lead">Insights, analysis, and thoughts on data science, analytics, and business intelligence</p>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="container blog-content">
    <div class="row" id="posts-container">
        <!-- Posts will be automatically generated by Quarto -->
    </div>
    
    <div class="no-posts" id="no-posts" style="display: none;">
        <i class="fas fa-blog"></i>
        <h3>No Posts Yet</h3>
        <p>Check back soon for new content!</p>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Add hover effects and enhance post cards
    const postCards = document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-grid-item');
    
    postCards.forEach(card => {
        // Add category tags if not present
        const title = card.querySelector('.listing-title');
        if (title) {
            const titleText = title.textContent.toLowerCase();
            let category = 'Data Analysis';
            
            if (titleText.includes('energy') || titleText.includes('duck')) {
                category = 'Energy Analytics';
            } else if (titleText.includes('ml') || titleText.includes('machine')) {
                category = 'Machine Learning';
            } else if (titleText.includes('viz') || titleText.includes('visual')) {
                category = 'Data Visualization';
            }
            
            const categoryTag = document.createElement('span');
            categoryTag.className = 'category-tag';
            categoryTag.textContent = category;
            
            const categoriesDiv = document.createElement('div');
            categoriesDiv.className = 'post-categories';
            categoriesDiv.appendChild(categoryTag);
            
            const content = card.querySelector('.listing-content');
            if (content) {
                content.appendChild(categoriesDiv);
            }
        }
        
        // Add read more link
        const link = card.querySelector('a');
        if (link) {
            const readMore = document.createElement('a');
            readMore.className = 'read-more';
            readMore.href = link.href;
            readMore.innerHTML = 'Read More <i class="fas fa-arrow-right"></i>';
            
            const content = card.querySelector('.listing-content');
            if (content) {
                content.appendChild(readMore);
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Show no posts message if no posts exist
    if (postCards.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('no-posts').style.display = 'block';
    }
});
</script>
